svg.text: Official Rio Grande Games Board Layout, Resource Market & Initial Card Market
3 contiguous regions active (3p) or 4 regions (4p); unused regions closed
Holds up to 2× listed fuel capacity
Turn Order Rules, Auction Loop, Reverse Buying/Building & Step 2/3 Triggers
1. Most connected cities on map goes 1st.
* Round 1 Special Rule: Determine order AFTER Phase 2!
• Max 3 Plants per Player: If buying a 4th plant, immediately scrap 1 existing plant (keep compatible fuel).
• No-Sale Rule: If nobody buys ANY plant in Phase 2, remove the lowest-numbered plant from Current Market.
• Buy Coal, Oil, Garbage, or Uranium from cheapest available slots in Resource Market.
• Storage Limit: Each plant holds up to 2× its listed fuel requirement (Hybrids hold Coal and/or Oil).
• Advantage: Trailing players buy cheaper fuel before leaders can drive up prices.
• First city: Pay 10 Elektro (any open city). Subsequent cities: Cheapest path cost + city slot cost (10/15/20).
• Destroy Obsolete Plants: Immediately discard any market plant with # ≤ any player's city count.
STEP 2 TRIGGER: When any player connects their 7th city, Step 2 starts at end of Phase 4 (2 slots/city open).
1. Power Cities & Earn Elektro: Spend fuel from plants to power up to your connected cities; collect payout
2. Resupply Resources: Refill market from right to left using the Step 1 / Step 2 / Step 3 player-count table.
3. Cycle Market: Move highest Future Market plant to bottom of deck & draw replacement (Steps 1–2).
* If Step 3 card drawn: Remove lowest plant & Step 3 card, shuffle deck, switch to 6-card single market.
END-GAME CHECK (End of Phase 4 / Final Phase 5)
Did a player reach target cities (17 for 3–4p)? Finish Phase 5:
Winner = Most POWERED cities (Tie: Most Elektro → Most cities).
